t: Meaning of the name Gentille
s: October 17, 2025 - The name Gentille is a feminine name of French origin, derived from the word "gentil," which means "noble," "well-born," "courteous," or "kind." It carries connotations of refinement, grace, and good manners. As such, it reflects the qualities of someone who is well-bred and amiable.
